body: Edits/reactions/topic ops get their own group bucket (EDIT_BUCKET, 20/min) next to the 20/min message bucket, total <=40/min; rejected one shared bucket with weights because edits (5 s status per slot) would starve content messages via the fairness rule (1 message per 5 requests under saturation). answerCallbackQuery takes no token.

Scheduler::new takes impl Into<Limits>; From<BucketConfig> keeps pre-TASK-054 behaviour (no debounce, edits unmetered) so the ~25 test call sites with fast buckets stay unchanged; only hub::run uses Limits::default(). Alternative (new fields on BucketConfig) would have forced editing every test literal and pushed a 1.5 s debounce into real-time e2e tests.

Verdict NEEDS_WORK: with EDIT_BUCKET the edit lane never empties under >=2 churning status slots, so Lane::Topic (createForumTopic/editForumTopic/pin/delete) starves (repro: createTopic not sent in 170 s) and user edits wait ~N*4 s (decision edit 42 s at n=10, breaks the 10 s CONFIRM_FOR of the stop button). Suggested: serve Topic before Edit and demote status edits to a background class; rejected accepting the debounce part alone since the hub path uses Limits::default for both.

Review issue 5 says make due() break at a same-topic permission prompt. Taken verbatim with orchestrator decision 4 it would keep the head line's due at last_line+1.5 s; next_message skips the prompt (its topic is already seen), so when the message bucket is empty pick sleeps until that due and the prompt waits for the debounce. Chosen: due() returns at once at a same-topic prompt (a stronger stop than break: lines after the prompt never extend the wait, lines before it flush without waiting). Alternative rejected: literal break.

Tried Topic lane strictly before all edits (decision 1 first option): in the Limits::default slots test the permission decision edit waited 14.9 s behind a pin and two icon edits (1 edit token per 4 s under status churn). Replaced by strict alternation Topic <-> foreground edits, background last; the decision then goes within 8 s.

The stop confirmation window (CONFIRM_FOR 10 s) now restarts when Telegram accepts the edit that first shows the question (on_status_done), in addition to making that edit foreground and letting it replace a queued refresh. Reason: with alternation a foreground edit can still need two edit tokens (8 s) in a burst, which is not well within 10 s counted from the press. Alternative rejected: a third urgent edit class above topic calls (more classes, topic calls could wait behind presses).

Background status refreshes stay FIFO in the edit queue instead of an explicit round-robin structure: per-message coalescing keeps one queued refresh per status message and pump_status resubmits only after the previous answer, so oldest-first over distinct messages is round-robin by slot (test every_status_refresh_goes_within_a_bound_and_the_slots_share_the_rest: counts differ by at most 1).

Round 2 verdict SHIP for 010b9c5: round-1 repro adapted to background refreshes gives createTopic 2 s / decision 6 s / reaction 10 s at n=10 (was never / 42 s / 46 s); 429 Superseded cannot pick an older-intent edit (one queued edit per message, pump_status blocks refreshes behind a stop edit). Remaining minors kept non-blocking: background refresh unbounded under foreground >=15/min (164 s repro), prompt may wait a token after the line flush, confirm window re-arms on every re-show. Alternative rejected: NEEDS_WORK for the starvation, since only cosmetic status freezes under heavy user-driven load.
